notes.title: 1.2 Demo Update
notes.notes: [p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45212460/0b448a9f4ba3ab8d8ea7cd388f807d367e8485f7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45212460/5ae434a0cfe7f72e287e3806f290652a8b2e9f55.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45212460/77f934ed7225a4bcadc9354cc56e65382489a071.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45212460/30cb85f1aa2beb21684eb8b8b2af570548e320d4.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]​I've released the 1.2 update for my demo, which I am polishing for the Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]Highlights of this update:[/p][list][*][p]PC Overhaul. I changed the way the desktop is rendered so that it renders onto the PC screen. Now the screen curves, has glare, and can have it's own processing effects[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul websites to make them more 90's consistent. i am using a bunch of new 90's graphics that I sourced[/p][/*][*][p]PC Settings window, Terminal. Adding more juice to the computer, you can change the settings of your PC. There's also a terminal window, but it's blocked by Danger Detective.[/p][/*][/list][p]I'm really happy with this update. The next update will focus more on making the IM windows work better, plus some story updates.[/p][p]Let me know if there is anything you want to see in the game![/p]
